title: Data and scraping for AI
intro: Tools that turn web pages, PDFs and documents into clean text or structured data that models can use.

projects.name: mineru
projects.tagline: Document parser that converts PDFs, images and Office files to Markdown and JSON

projects.name: Firecrawl

projects.name: langextract

projects.name: scrapegraph-ai
projects.tagline: Python library that builds LLM-driven scraping pipelines from a prompt and a URL

projects.name: marker

projects.name: pdfmathtranslate

projects.name: paddleocr

projects.name: opendataloader-pdf
